summary: Ignore whitespace-only plain-text MIME alternatives when selecting an email body so non-empty safe HTML can supply workflow evidence.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and email content
Existing requirement to prefer usable plain text while safely supporting visible HTML email bodies
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued email and workflow adaptability improvements.
known_limitations: When both plain and HTML alternatives contain non-empty but different text, plain text remains authoritative and the alternatives are not semantically reconciled.
MSG, mailbox synchronization and malformed MIME recovery beyond Python's standard email parser remain unsupported.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no mailbox, model or external provider request is used.
